report.limits: IDAT 优化保留其他 PNG 块；Atlas 兼容模式重建普通 PNG，原生模式由 Preview/Player 直接绘制共享图集图块，异常使用随包普通纹理回退。原生组按整体交付成本计账（含 Base64、清单、压缩回退包），组内单素材行仅描述普通纹理，不可与组成本重复相加。统计不等于 ZIP/HTML 总大小；原生图集/画布/读回预算 64 MiB，回退解压合计上限 32 MiB，不包含普通图片回退解码、JS/Blob/驱动开销，不是整个浏览器或实际 GPU 测量，不保证降低内存或 Draw Call。源工程原 Blob 不修改，恢复原素材导出后重新构建即可恢复原文件。

limits: Native shared Atlas bitmap tile drawing into per-image Canvas; compressed original fallback embedded. CSS IMG and Canvas sampling differs: native screenshot is compared exactly to an ordinary-source Canvas control, not claimed identical to IMG. Preview and intrinsic pixels remain exact. Budget accounting is not GPU/heap measurement. Deterministic uncompressed fixture is not a production savings claim; device/human validation outstanding. Process snapshots are aggregate private/working-set bytes, not isolated asset allocation or guaranteed peaks; end-to-end timings include harness pacing. Per-asset playback coverage is recorded in dicing-sequence when requested; scale mode alone verifies 30 variants at build, not playback.
